<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex041022026-07-0803-06-54" status="unreviewed">'bras bu med la ni thar pa'i ste mngon mtho tsam spyod ses dge bar skyes pas thob pa yang yod pas so || zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4243">'ban</rs> zer ba ltar ro || 
               
               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3921">tho</rs> ni lta ba nyon mongs can gyis kun nas bsla pa'i las chos can
               <lb n="N008"/> mi deg ba ma yin par thal 'bras bu mngon mtho skyed pa yod pa'i phyir ro || 
               'dod na rin chen shreng pa las 'dod chags zhe sdgag gti mu bcas || des skyes las ni mi deg ba || ma chags zhn srang gnyi mu med | de bskyed las ni dg pa yin || zhes pa dang 'gal lo || </seg></TEI>
